273334.name: F.R.E.E. of Brighton Beach - The Jewish Russian Community Center
273334.note: F.R.E.E.'s own site: 'It was Rabbi Herhel Okunov who, in 1988, founded the FREE Center of Brighton Beach at the behest of the Rebbe, in the old Hebrew Alliance Synagogue in Brighton Beach' (2915 Brighton 6th Street). F.R.E.E. itself dates from 1969 (its headquarters in Crown Heights).

609491.name: Mazel Day School
609491.note: Its own history: founded by F.R.E.E., 'Mazel Day School opened in 2002 when a small group of Russian-speaking parents sought a high-quality education rooted in their Jewish heritage'; 'Our coed private day school was founded in 2002'. It grew from the Mazel Day Care preschool at the FREE Center of Brighton Beach (Rabbi Avremel and Chani Okonov). (A CUNY student page has 2006, likely the later expansion.)

117971.name: Chabad Association for Georgian Jews
117971.note: Rabbi Aharon Chein's biography (NY Beth Din site): in 1992 the Lubavitcher Rebbe asked him to devote himself to the growing Georgian community in Queens, and he founded the Chabad Association for Georgian Jews that year (today 66-40 Saunders St.). Medium: one source, read through a search summary (the page doesn't answer plain requests).
